answer: The ember test I would run is Warranted tour guide licence with tour guides association attestation: a licence the association renews after assessed tours, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence the association renews after assessed tours — so privacy survives, and the nadir is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the haven of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
